--- /dev/null
+++ b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
@@ -0,0 +1,415 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable           bool
+	hashPolicies      []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	defaultedSourceIP bool
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherCH.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if err := hp.Validate(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if h := hp.GetHeader(); h != nil && h.GetRegexRewrite() != nil && h.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern() != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:           c.disable,
+		hashPolicies:      slices.Clone(c.hashPolicies),
+		defaultedSourceIP: c.defaultedSourceIP,
+	}
+}
+
+func defaultSourceIPHashPolicy() *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+			ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},
+		Terminal: false,
+	}
+}
+
+func parseCookieTTL(ttlStr string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr); err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must not be negative: %q", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(d), nil
+	}
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl must not be negative: %q", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(secs) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: must be a Go duration string or integer seconds", ttlStr)
+}
+
+func deduplicateHeaderHashPolicies(policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(policies))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(policies))
+	for _, p := range policies {
+		h := p.GetHeader()
+		if h == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.GetHeaderName())
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, p)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func deduplicateCookieHashPolicies(policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(policies))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(policies))
+	for _, p := range policies {
+		c := p.GetCookie()
+		if c == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		key := c.GetName()
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, p)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func deduplicateQueryParamHashPolicies(policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(policies))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(policies))
+	for _, p := range policies {
+		q := p.GetQueryParameter()
+		if q == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		key := q.GetName()
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, p)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func deduplicateFilterStateHashPolicies(policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(policies))
+	out := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(policies))
+	for _, p := range policies {
+		f := p.GetFilterState()
+		if f == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		key := f.GetKey()
+		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[key] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, p)
+	}
+	return out
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch.Disable {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var headers []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		rawHeaders := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(ch.Headers))
+		for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+			var regexRewrite *envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute
+			if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+				regexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+					Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+						Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+					},
+					Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+				}
+			}
+			rawHeaders = append(rawHeaders, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+					Header: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+						HeaderName:   h.HeaderName,
+						RegexRewrite: regexRewrite,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: h.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+		headers = deduplicateHeaderHashPolicies(rawHeaders)
+	}
+
+	var cookies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		rawCookies := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(ch.Cookies))
+		for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+			var ttl *durationpb.Duration
+			if c.TTL != "" {
+				var err error
+				ttl, err = parseCookieTTL(c.TTL)
+				if err != nil {
+					return err
+				}
+			}
+			var attrs []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute
+			if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+				attrs = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+				for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+					attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+						Name:  attr.Name,
+						Value: attr.Value,
+					})
+				}
+			}
+			rawCookies = append(rawCookies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+					Cookie: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+						Name:       c.Name,
+						Ttl:        ttl,
+						Path:       c.Path,
+						Attributes: attrs,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: c.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+		cookies = deduplicateCookieHashPolicies(rawCookies)
+	}
+
+	var queryParams []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		rawQueryParams := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+		for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+			rawQueryParams = append(rawQueryParams, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+					QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+						Name: q.Name,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: q.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+		queryParams = deduplicateQueryParamHashPolicies(rawQueryParams)
+	}
+
+	var filterState []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		rawFilterState := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(ch.FilterState))
+		for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+			rawFilterState = append(rawFilterState, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+					FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+						Key: f.Key,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: f.Terminal,
+			})
+		}
+		filterState = deduplicateFilterStateHashPolicies(rawFilterState)
+	}
+
+	var sourceIP *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		sourceIP = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ch.SourceIP.Terminal,
+		}
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	policies = append(policies, headers...)
+	policies = append(policies, cookies...)
+	policies = append(policies, queryParams...)
+	policies = append(policies, filterState...)
+	if sourceIP != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, sourceIP)
+	}
+
+	defaulted := false
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		defaulted = true
+		policies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies:      policies,
+		defaultedSourceIP: defaulted,
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func extractHashPoliciesByType(c *consistentHashIR) (
+	headers []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+	cookies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+	queryParams []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+	filterState []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+	sourceIP *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+) {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		switch {
+		case hp.GetHeader() != nil:
+			headers = append(headers, hp)
+		case hp.GetCookie() != nil:
+			cookies = append(cookies, hp)
+		case hp.GetQueryParameter() != nil:
+			queryParams = append(queryParams, hp)
+		case hp.GetFilterState() != nil:
+			filterState = append(filterState, hp)
+		case hp.GetConnectionProperties() != nil:
+			if !c.defaultedSourceIP && sourceIP == nil {
+				sourceIP = hp
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return headers, cookies, queryParams, filterState, sourceIP
+}
+
+func unionConsistentHashIR(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	hHeaders, hCookies, hQueryParams, hFilterState, hSourceIP := extractHashPoliciesByType(high)
+	lHeaders, lCookies, lQueryParams, lFilterState, _ := extractHashPoliciesByType(low)
+
+	headers := deduplicateHeaderHashPolicies(slices.Concat(hHeaders, lHeaders))
+	cookies := deduplicateCookieHashPolicies(slices.Concat(hCookies, lCookies))
+	queryParams := deduplicateQueryParamHashPolicies(slices.Concat(hQueryParams, lQueryParams))
+	filterState := deduplicateFilterStateHashPolicies(slices.Concat(hFilterState, lFilterState))
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	policies = append(policies, headers...)
+	policies = append(policies, cookies...)
+	policies = append(policies, queryParams...)
+	policies = append(policies, filterState...)
+	if hSourceIP != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, hSourceIP)
+	}
+
+	defaulted := false
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		defaulted = true
+		policies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+	}
+
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies:      policies,
+		defaultedSourceIP: defaulted,
+	}
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	if len(consistentHash.hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.hashPolicies
+}

+		b        *consistentHashIR

+func TestMergeConsistentHashPolicies(t *testing.T) {
+	gk := schema.GroupKind{Group: "gateway.kgateway.dev", Kind: "TrafficPolicy"}
+
+	buildPolicyAtt := func(name string, ch *kgateway.ConsistentHash) ir.PolicyAtt {
+		specIr := &trafficPolicySpecIr{}
+		err := constructConsistentHash(kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec{ConsistentHash: ch}, specIr)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		return ir.PolicyAtt{
+			GroupKind: gk,
+			PolicyRef: &ir.AttachedPolicyRef{
+				Group:     "gateway.kgateway.dev",
+				Kind:      "TrafficPolicy",
+				Namespace: "default",
+				Name:      name,
+			},
+			PolicyIr: &TrafficPolicy{
+				spec: *specIr,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	t.Run("multiple policies union arrays with higher-priority first, deduplicate, re-sort into canonical order, and retain higher-priority unset sourceIp", func(t *testing.T) {
+		// Higher priority policy has cookies and headers, and sourceIp unset
+		high := buildPolicyAtt("high-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Cookies: []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie{
+				{Name: "cookie-shared", Path: "/high", Terminal: false},
+				{Name: "cookie-high", Path: "/h", Terminal: true},
+			},
+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+				{HeaderName: "X-Shared-Header", Terminal: false},
+			},
+		})
+
+		// Lower priority policy has headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, and sourceIp set
+		low := buildPolicyAtt("low-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+				{HeaderName: "x-shared-header", Terminal: true},
+				{HeaderName: "x-low-header", Terminal: true},
+			},
+			Cookies: []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie{
+				{Name: "cookie-shared", Path: "/low", Terminal: true},
+				{Name: "cookie-low", Path: "/l", Terminal: false},
+			},
+			QueryParameters: []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter{
+				{Name: "qp1", Terminal: false},
+			},
+			FilterState: []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState{
+				{Key: "fs1", Terminal: true},
+			},
+			SourceIP: &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{Terminal: true},
+		})
+
+		merged := policy.MergePolicies([]ir.PolicyAtt{high, low}, mergeTrafficPolicies, "")
+		tp := merged.PolicyIr.(*TrafficPolicy)
+		require.NotNil(t, tp.spec.consistentHash)
+
+		// Expected canonical order:
+		// 0: Header "X-Shared-Header" (from high, terminal=false)
+		// 1: Header "x-low-header" (from low, terminal=true)
+		// 2: Cookie "cookie-shared" (from high, path="/high", terminal=false)
+		// 3: Cookie "cookie-high" (from high, path="/h", terminal=true)
+		// 4: Cookie "cookie-low" (from low, path="/l", terminal=false)
+		// 5: QueryParameter "qp1" (from low, terminal=false)
+		// 6: FilterState "fs1" (from low, terminal=true)
+		// (No sourceIp because high-policy had sourceIp unset!)
+		hps := tp.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies
+		require.Len(t, hps, 7)
+
+		assert.Equal(t, "X-Shared-Header", hps[0].GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+		assert.False(t, hps[0].GetTerminal())
+
+		assert.Equal(t, "x-low-header", hps[1].GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+		assert.True(t, hps[1].GetTerminal())
+
+		assert.Equal(t, "cookie-shared", hps[2].GetCookie().GetName())
+		assert.Equal(t, "/high", hps[2].GetCookie().GetPath())
+		assert.False(t, hps[2].GetTerminal())
+
+		assert.Equal(t, "cookie-high", hps[3].GetCookie().GetName())
+		assert.Equal(t, "/h", hps[3].GetCookie().GetPath())
+		assert.True(t, hps[3].GetTerminal())
+
+		assert.Equal(t, "cookie-low", hps[4].GetCookie().GetName())
+		assert.Equal(t, "/l", hps[4].GetCookie().GetPath())
+		assert.False(t, hps[4].GetTerminal())
+
+		assert.Equal(t, "qp1", hps[5].GetQueryParameter().GetName())
+		assert.False(t, hps[5].GetTerminal())
+
+		assert.Equal(t, "fs1", hps[6].GetFilterState().GetKey())
+		assert.True(t, hps[6].GetTerminal())
+
+		// Verify mergeOrigins records consistentHash for both policies
+		require.Len(t, merged.MergeOrigins["consistentHash"], 2)
+		assert.True(t, merged.MergeOrigins["consistentHash"].Has("gateway.kgateway.dev/TrafficPolicy/default/high-policy"))
+		assert.True(t, merged.MergeOrigins["consistentHash"].Has("gateway.kgateway.dev/TrafficPolicy/default/low-policy"))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("higher-priority sourceIp is retained when set", func(t *testing.T) {
+		high := buildPolicyAtt("high-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			SourceIP: &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{Terminal: true},
+		})
+		low := buildPolicyAtt("low-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+				{HeaderName: "x-low", Terminal: false},
+			},
+			SourceIP: &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIP{Terminal: false},
+		})
+
+		merged := policy.MergePolicies([]ir.PolicyAtt{high, low}, mergeTrafficPolicies, "")
+		tp := merged.PolicyIr.(*TrafficPolicy)
+		require.NotNil(t, tp.spec.consistentHash)
+		hps := tp.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies
+		require.Len(t, hps, 2)
+
+		// Canonical order: header first, then sourceIp (with high's terminal=true)
+		assert.Equal(t, "x-low", hps[0].GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+		require.NotNil(t, hps[1].GetConnectionProperties())
+		assert.True(t, hps[1].GetConnectionProperties().GetSourceIp())
+		assert.True(t, hps[1].GetTerminal())
+	})
+
+	t.Run("disable=true in higher-priority policy suppresses broader-scoped policy", func(t *testing.T) {
+		high := buildPolicyAtt("disable-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Disable: true,
+		})
+		low := buildPolicyAtt("broader-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+				{HeaderName: "x-user", Terminal: true},
+			},
+		})
+
+		merged := policy.MergePolicies([]ir.PolicyAtt{high, low}, mergeTrafficPolicies, "")
+		tp := merged.PolicyIr.(*TrafficPolicy)
+		require.NotNil(t, tp.spec.consistentHash)
+		assert.True(t, tp.spec.consistentHash.disable)
+		assert.Empty(t, tp.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies)
+
+		route := &envoyroutev3.Route{
+			Action: &envoyroutev3.Route_Route{
+				Route: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction{},
+			},
+		}
+		applyConsistentHash(tp.spec.consistentHash, route)
+		assert.Empty(t, route.GetRoute().GetHashPolicy())
+	})
+
+	t.Run("disable=true in child hierarchy suppresses broader-scoped parent hierarchy policy", func(t *testing.T) {
+		child := buildPolicyAtt("child-disable", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Disable: true,
+		})
+		child.HierarchicalPriority = 0
+
+		parent := buildPolicyAtt("parent-policy", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+				{HeaderName: "x-parent", Terminal: true},
+			},
+		})
+		parent.HierarchicalPriority = -1
+
+		merged := policy.MergePolicies([]ir.PolicyAtt{child, parent}, mergeTrafficPolicies, "")
+		tp := merged.PolicyIr.(*TrafficPolicy)
+		require.NotNil(t, tp.spec.consistentHash)
+		assert.True(t, tp.spec.consistentHash.disable)
+		assert.Empty(t, tp.spec.consistentHash.hashPolicies)
+		require.Len(t, merged.MergeOrigins["consistentHash"], 1)
+		assert.True(t, merged.MergeOrigins["consistentHash"].Has("gateway.kgateway.dev/TrafficPolicy/default/child-disable"))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("ApplyForRoute applies consistentHash to RouteAction", func(t *testing.T) {
+		plugin := &trafficPolicyPluginGwPass{}
+		pol := buildPolicyAtt("route-hash", &kgateway.ConsistentHash{})
+		pCtx := &ir.RouteContext{Policy: pol.PolicyIr}
+		out := &envoyroutev3.Route{
+			Action: &envoyroutev3.Route_Route{
+				Route: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction{},
+			},
+		}
+		require.NoError(t, plugin.ApplyForRoute(pCtx, out))
+		require.Len(t, out.GetRoute().GetHashPolicy(), 1)
+		require.NotNil(t, out.GetRoute().GetHashPolicy()[0].GetConnectionProperties())
+		assert.True(t, out.GetRoute().GetHashPolicy()[0].GetConnectionProperties().GetSourceIp())
+		assert.False(t, out.GetRoute().GetHashPolicy()[0].GetTerminal())
+	})
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	switch opts.Strategy {
+	case policy.AugmentedShallowMerge, policy.AugmentedDeepMerge:
+		if p1.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			return
+		}
+		if p2.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			return
+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = unionConsistentHashIR(p1.spec.consistentHash, p2.spec.consistentHash)
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	case policy.OverridableShallowMerge, policy.OverridableDeepMerge:
+		if p1.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			return
+		}
+		if p2.spec.consistentHash.disable {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.clone()
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+			return
+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = unionConsistentHashIR(p2.spec.consistentHash, p1.spec.consistentHash)
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+
+	default:
+		logger.Warn("unsupported merge strategy for policy", "strategy", opts.Strategy, "policy", p2Ref, "field", "consistentHash")
+	}
